chunks: Whether We show you some of the promise (of punishment in wait) for them, or take you to Ourself, their returning is to Us in the end; and God is a witness to all they do.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the disbelievers whether the Prophet sees their punishment or dies?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual possibility of the Prophet witnessing the punishment or passing away, affirming that divine accountability remains constant regardless of the Prophet's temporal presence. It underscores the concept of 'Ruj'ah' (return) to God as the ultimate judge, reinforcing the idea that God's witness encompasses all hidden and manifest deeds. This verse is often cited to comfort the Prophet and believers during periods of delay in divine retribution.
